mechanics_notes: Strike Super whose clock-hand blades can be extended through additional inputs for up to four hits, consuming additional Ki; current documentation reports 100 Ki for the first input and up to 300 Ki for the full sequence, with about 15% total damage. Each successful hit builds a Power of Time/Holy Inscription stack that produces a shockwave and powers related Chronoa skills, including Kairos Cannon and Temporal Holy Ray. Current evidence supports up to four hits and the cross-skill empowerment, while exact stack consumption/timing and frame data remain bounded.
evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence only; unresolved numerical/frame details remain bounded.
